literal_meaning: হাতির পাঁচটি পা দেখা (elephant's five legs being seen)
figurative_meaning_en: Considering the impossible as possible due to arrogance
similar_in_english: Biting off more than one can chew
example_sentences_in_bangla: অহঙ্কারে সে হাতীর পাঁচ পা দেখছে, মনে করছে সব সম্ভব।
এই প্রকল্পটি সম্পূর্ণ অসম্ভব, কিন্তু তার হাতীর পাঁচ পা দেখা হচ্ছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Due to his arrogance, he is seeing five legs on an elephant, thinking everything is possible.
This project is utterly impossible, but he's seeing five legs on an elephant in his hubris.
history: The idiom derives from the biological fact that elephants have four legs, rendering the sight of five legs impossible, symbolizing delusional thinking induced by excessive pride in Bengali oral traditions.
note: This idiom highlights overconfidence leading to unrealistic perceptions, deeply embedded in everyday Bengali speech.
